findings.title: Full accessibility breadth scan (68 routes) is triage-only and not a required check
evidence: .github/workflows/a11y-breadth.yml:1-19 header states it is "a triage report, not a gate" and "not referenced by any required check"
apps/web/e2e/a11y.spec.ts:34-56 FULL_PAGES runs only when A11Y_FULL=1; the default gate uses BASE_PAGES (25 routes)
.github/workflows/a11y-breadth.yml:17-19 only runs workflow_dispatch + a weekly schedule
findings.impact: Regressions on the ~68-route breadth set surface only in an advisory weekly job, so accessibility can regress on routes outside the 25-page default gate without blocking a merge.
findings.recommendation: Ratchet the breadth set into the default gate in batches (start with the currently-green pages), record a violation baseline, and make new violations fail the E2E gate.

report: Read-only analysis at main `9c0b88c` (2026-10-04). No findings identified for this domain in the 9c0b88c reconciliation pass. Reconciliation full-domain pass at main `9c0b88c` (2026-10-04).
